text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for this year's summer camp! I got plenty of sleep this time, so I'm raring to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just wait for me, Queen Elizabeth II Cup! Now that I've gotten stronger, I'll send my foes spinning with my Princess☆Hell Wheel!
